nodes.name: Bed: steel ladder frame, MDF spoilboard, X rails and racks
Gantry: box column with a 2:1 Y counterweight inside, feet on 2 x HGR25 X rails, 2 x NEMA34 rack drive
Y carriage on 2 x HGR25 rails, SFU2520 screw, 30T:20T belt step-up, NEMA34, 24 V brake
Z axis: plate on 2 x HGR25, SFU2010 with 40T:20T belt step-up, NEMA34
Salvaged 9 kW ISO30 ATC spindle, 380 V 3-ph 800 Hz
Linear tool rack beside the sheet
Floor frame with front outriggers, rear posts, levelling feet
Cabinet: new Delta MS300 2.2 kW 1-ph VFD (space left for a 11 kW 400 V one), salvaged PSUs, drivers, controller, E-stop

requirements.text: X travel shall put the tool centre past both 2400 mm sheet edges by tool radius + 3 mm
Y travel shall put the tool centre past both 1200 mm sheet edges by tool radius + 3 mm
Z travel shall be at least 300 mm
The bed shall lean back 10 deg from vertical
The tool shall reach 2 mm into the spoilboard
The machine shall be no taller than 1800 mm in any pose (the X and Z cable chains and their brackets excepted)
The X and Z cable chains and their brackets shall clear a 2400 mm ceiling by 100 mm
The floor frame shall be no deeper than 1000 mm front to back
With the gantry parked in the corner, the bed and floor frame shall be no deeper than 1000 mm (the head's overhang while cutting is accepted)
No two parts shall overlap (posed mid-sheet)
Floor frame shall not overlap the bed
Retracted, gantry and head shall clear the bed, racks, ATC, floor frame and clamps over all X travel
Plunged, the head shall clear everything but the cut over the sheet
The head shall clear the gantry and bed over all Y travel
Parked, the gantry shall leave the whole sheet open for loading from the front
The centre of mass shall stay at least 150 mm inside the feet front-to-back in every pose
It shall not tip forward with a 300 N pull at its top
The motor envelope used for clash checks shall contain the 34E1K-120 STEP model
X drive torque margin at rapid, cutting feed, and the largest 3-phase cut
Y drive torque margin, lifting the head up the slope
Z drive torque margin
Y screw critical speed shall be at least 1.25 x its rapid speed
With power off the head shall not run down the slope: brake torque >= 2 x back-driving torque
If the counterweight rope breaks, the brake shall still hold the whole head: brake torque >= 1.25 x its back-driving torque
Counterweight rope: breaking load >= 5 x its working tension
Sheaves shall be at least 20 rope diameters across, for rope life
The counterweight shall stay inside the column, clear of its walls, caps and the top sheave, over all Y travel
The counterweight rope shall run clear of every part from its anchor to the sheave, over all Y travel
The Z axis and spindle shall clear the Y carriage, Z screw and its supports over the whole Z stroke
Each ball-nut flange shall clear the faces either side of it by at least 3 mm
Each cable chain shall keep both runs and its loop inside its zone over the whole travel (least margin)
Cable chains shall bend no tighter than 7.5 x the largest continuous-flex cable
Each cable chain shall be no more than 60 % full
Each cable chain's inner height shall take its largest cable
The column shall deflect no more than 0.02 mm under the largest cutting force (now or on 3-phase) at mid-height
The top rail beam shall deflect no more than 0.02 mm between rear posts under the gantry's normal load and the cut
The spoilboard shall deflect no more than 0.05 mm under a 100 N plunge force between cross members
Column twist shall move the tool no more than 0.01 mm under the cutting force
Tool deflection from the structure under the cutting force shall be no more than 0.05 mm
Rail mounting faces: each pair coplanar and parallel within 0.05 mm over its length, after welding (machined lands, or epoxy-levelled strips)

extra.why: a fabrication and inspection step: check with a straightedge and dial gauge

requirements.text: Weldments stress-relieved or welded in a balanced sequence before the rail lands are finished
Each motor's peak draw shall be within its 60 V 350 W supply
The VFD shall run the spindle to 24 000 rpm (800 Hz)
VFD output current at the power cap shall be within its 11 A rating at every speed
Spindle current shall stay within its own 17.8 A rating
Continuous draw from the circuit shall be no more than 80 % of 15 A
Spindle shaft power within the circuit shall cover a full-depth 18 mm ply slot at 6 m/min
Salvaged E-stop, PSUs and controller wired to AS/NZS 3000 and AS/NZS 4024 (STO on the VFD, E-stop drops all drives)

extra.why: wiring, not geometry; for an electrician

requirements.text: The sheet shall not move while cut (screws or clamps; vacuum does not fit the circuit)
The spindle's cooling fan shall run from the cabinet (check its nameplate: a 380 V 3-ph fan needs its own supply on 1-ph)
Guarding: the head sweeps the space in front of the bed at 0.3-1.6 m height

extra.why: a safety review of the installed machine

requirements.text: Each part of the head, detailed part by part, shall weigh no more than the allowance the counterweight and Y drive were sized for (detail / allowance)
The detailed counterweight shall weigh the mass the Y drive check used, within 5 %
Every detailed part shall lie inside the envelope the clash checks used
At each tool pocket the empty spindle, Z axis and carriage shall clear the fork plate, its stands and the other holders
A held tool shall slide into its fork through the slot without touching the fork, the other holders, the spoilboard or a 25 mm sheet
While cutting, the tool tip shall stay within 0.1 mm of the programmed path (servo lag, drive springs and column bending)
fragile: drive stiffness (belts, rack, screws) is x0.5
carriage friction (blocks, seals, nuts) is x2

requirements.text: No axis shall ask for more than 80 % of its motors' pull-out torque at the speed it is running, in any job
Each 60 V supply's load, averaged over 100 ms, shall stay within its 350 W rating in every job
Braking energy shall not lift any 60 V bus above 90 V (the drivers trip at 100 V)
Mains current averaged over any 1 s shall stay within the 15 A circuit, in every job
The counterweight rope shall never go slack: least tension at least half its static tension, in every job
While cutting, the spindle shall hold within 10 % of its set speed (VFD power cap against the cut)
Each drive and column mode shall be at least 2.5 x the drivers' 20 Hz position-loop bandwidth, so the loop does not excite it

On a total power failure at rapid, no axis shall run past where the controller would have stopped it by more than it can: X 53 mm of rail beyond the travel, Y none, Z the 10 mm clearance over the sheet
fragile: carriage friction (blocks, seals, nuts) is x0.5

requirements.text: After a power failure every axis shall hold still: Y on its brake, Z and X on friction and detent (movement 2 s on)
On a power failure the counterweight rope's peak tension shall stay within its breaking load / 5, as the head stops and the block runs on
Each drive's simulated natural frequency shall match the two-mass formula sqrt(k (1/m + 1/J G^2)) / 2 pi within 1 %
With losses and the loop off, a ringing drive's energy shall drift no more than 0.1 % over a second (the solver adds or loses none)
At a steady rapid, each motor's simulated torque shall equal the force balance (friction, drag, gravity, counterweight, detent) within 1 %
Left alone where it starts, the simulated tool tip shall move no more than 0.1 um (the model starts in equilibrium)
Halving the solver's time step shall change no simulated result by more than 2 %
Every cable and hose shall run from a real device, through the cable chains its axis needs (in order), to a real terminal in the cabinet, and be laid and terminated in a step (faults)
The cabinet shall stay within 10 K of the room: its filter fan moves enough air for the heat its walls can't shed (m3/h)
The assembly procedure shall fit every part in exactly one step (parts not fitted, or fitted twice)
Each bench-built unit shall be finished before it is fitted, and fitted once
No one shall lift, push or hold more than 25 kg in any step (2 people, no hoist)

Every joint shall have its fasteners through real holes, enough thread engaged (1.0 d in steel, 1.5 d in 6061), heads and nuts seated on material and clear of everything else, fitted no earlier than its parts (fasteners failing)
Every weld shall join parts that touch, welded no earlier than both are fitted (welds failing)
No two parts shall overlap in the built machine (shared volume, mm^3; meshing teeth, belts on pulleys, chains and rope excepted)
The cabinet, stand, ducts, sensors, E-stop and air parts shall clear every moving part over the whole travel (shared volume, mm^3, worst of 12 poses)
Every part shall reach its place along its stated path without touching what is already fitted (shared volume, mm^3)
Every fastener shall be reachable by its tool at the step it is tightened: a hex key straight down its axis for the key's short arm, a socket or a spanner from some side on nuts (shared volume, mm^3)
Every step of the build shall play back in the 3D viewer with all of its parts (parts a step names that the viewer lacks)

assumptions.text: Bed tilt is 10 deg from vertical
assumptions.reason: answer to a question; the sketch shows 20 deg (110 deg)

assumptions.text: The 300 on the sketch is the Z travel
Stock up to 25 mm, cutter up to 12 mm, workholding no taller than 40 mm
One 60 V 350 W supply per driver
assumptions.reason: user confirmed: four supplies, one per motor

assumptions.text: Motor torque follows the published 48 V DM860T pull-out curve
assumptions.reason: the 60 V supplies and the closed-loop drivers differ from the test

assumptions.text: Spindle is the 380 V version: 17.8 A rated, 29 kg, no-load current 35 % of rated
assumptions.reason: user's correction; figures from the same-body GDZ143x133-9

assumptions.text: On a future 3-phase supply the largest cut is a 25 mm cutter, 25 mm deep, at 10 m/min and 12 000 rpm
assumptions.reason: the steppers' speed, not the spindle, caps it

assumptions.text: Dust collector and compressor run on other circuits
assumptions.reason: the 15 A circuit cannot also carry them

assumptions.text: Rapids X 15, Y 10, Z 5 m/min; 1 m/s^2; 300 N cutting force at 6 m/min
The X and Z cable chains may stand above 1800 mm; the ceiling is 2400 mm
assumptions.reason: user: the 1800 mm limit is for assembly and operating ergonomics; Y can be jogged down to work on the Z chain. Ceiling not given

assumptions.text: The head may overhang the floor frame while cutting; parked at the left end it sits in the room's corner
assumptions.reason: user accepted the 1342 mm cutting envelope

assumptions.text: Sheet is located on retractable (pop-up) pins along its bottom edge, so the cutter can profile that edge
assumptions.reason: a fixed ledge would be cut

assumptions.text: Drive stiffness from catalogue orders of magnitude: HTD 5M belt EA 120 kN, rack mesh 100 N/um, ball nut 200 N/um
assumptions.reason: no stiffness data for the salvaged parts; the simulation's vibration results scale with them

assumptions.text: Each 60 V bus has 2200 uF and the supplies cannot sink current; the drivers trip above 100 V DC
assumptions.reason: typical for open-frame supplies and closed-loop stepper drivers; measure the salvaged ones

assumptions.text: Spindle rotor 0.003 kg m^2, 400 W of bearing and windage loss at 24 000 rpm
The drivers' position loop closes at 20 Hz on the motor encoder
assumptions.reason: a closed-loop stepper driver's usual tuning

assumptions.text: On a power failure the controller stops at once; the drivers trip below 20 V or at one turn of position error; the Y brake holds 50 ms after the mains goes; unpowered motors give 0.15 N m of detent torque
assumptions.reason: closed-loop stepper drivers' and spring brakes' usual behaviour; measure them
